title: The open notebook
passage: My notes held observations rather than a final verdict. One practice felt useful, another felt crowded, and a third was still unclear. I chose one question for the next day and closed the notebook. There was enough information for a small next step.
steps: Read aloud once in your ordinary way.
Choose one feature or tool to explore.
Read the same text again with that one choice.
Save one observation and one real-life use.
reflection: What changed in effort or meaning?
